evals.name: demo-repo-review-artifact
evals.prompt: Can you make me an artifact to help me review the last commit in /tmp/pr-review-guide-demo? (Create it first with `sh assets/demo/make_repo.sh /tmp/pr-review-guide-demo`.)
evals.expected_output: Uses base main~1. Writes a config with an overview: a summary, before/after (immediate retries become backoff, and HTTP errors are no longer returned as data), an architecture graph whose nodes are tagged added/changed/removed and link to their sections or files, a high-level data_flow sequence diagram from caller to server, a layout table, decisions grouped by area (error handling, retry policy) and tagged by impact, an empty API list shown as "No API changes", a Metrics table listing the new "withRetry gave up" warning log, and an empty flags list shown as "No feature flags". Each section has its own data_flow: the retry loop for retry.ts, the response.ok branch for client.ts. The retry section models withRetry as a state machine (Attempting, the new Waiting state, Resolved and Failed as final states) with real events as transition labels. The sections tell a story in review order, retry.ts before client.ts, and each has a one-sentence bridge from the section before. Notes are short, with one idea each. The deleted legacyRetry.ts is in the retry section. Changes are grouped into Added, Modified and Deleted with High/Medium/Low tags; the response.ok guard is High. Every diagram element (nodes, states, participants, edges, transitions, messages, fragments, alt branches and groups) has a tip saying what it is and what it does, so the builder prints no missing-tip warnings. Line notes sit on lines that appear in the diff. A Tests table lists backoffDelay's test as Added and Unit, and notes that withRetry is untested. The header shows the tokens and estimated cost of building the guide. Builds with scripts/build.py without errors, syntax-checks the script and publishes with the Artifact tool.

evals.name: pr-with-generated-files
evals.prompt: Write up a review guide for PR #482 so I can go through it properly. Half the diff is translated locale files.
evals.expected_output: Finds the merge-base from the PR's base branch. Puts generated locale files in skip_prefixes and names them in meta_extra, keeping the source-of-truth locale. Every other changed file is in a section; the builder's missing-file check passes. Test rows come from tests_inventory.py, refined by reading the test bodies, with renames marked 'rename only' and replacements named for removed tests. Notes are checked against the code before publishing.

evals.name: feedback-changes-template
evals.prompt: On the review guide you made, the sections are too long. Make the Added/Modified/Deleted lists collapsible, and keep it that way for future guides.
evals.expected_output: Edits assets/template.html (and build.py if needed) in the skill, not only the generated page. Rebuilds and republishes to the same artifact URL.

evals.name: pr-with-eval-fixtures
evals.prompt: Make a review guide for PR #91. It adds a new eval with about 30 sample PDFs and DOCX files under evals/data/.
evals.expected_output: Lists the sample documents in the fixtures of the section holding the eval, using an evals/data/ prefix or one entry per file, not in files or skip_prefixes. Writes a fixtures summary saying what the data is and which eval uses it, and a note per file or prefix on what it holds. The page shows no diff or line notes for the fixtures, and the eval code itself stays in files with its diff. Builds without errors.
